subject: Wellspire - runtime enablement & structured output plan
messages:
From: Anna Li <anna@wellspire.health>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Real-time output + tool-calling kickoff

Hi Olga and Ben,

Thanks again for the demo today — the streaming + function calling example was exactly what our product team needed to see. We want to move forward with a pilot that exercises: streaming partial outputs into our UI, two-way tool calls (search & annotation APIs), and a structured JSON output schema for charting.

High-level constraints from our side:
- All PHI must remain in our VPC (we'll use Redwood Private).
- Expected peak: ~75 req/s, average 20 req/s during business hours.
- Typical response length is 200-600 tokens; some longer reports up to ~1,500 tokens.

Can you send an implementation checklist (owners, artifacts you need from us, timeline, and a lightweight validation schema)? We're hoping for a 6-week pilot timeline.

Attachments: sample payloads coming from my engineer (Carlos).

Anna Li
Director of Product
Wellspire Health

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.inference>
To: Anna Li <anna@wellspire.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-04-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Real-time output + tool-calling kickoff

Anna — great to hear and excited to run the pilot. I put together an initial mutual action grid and a first-pass JSON schema for the structured outputs; attaching both so you have artifacts to react to.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
1) Week 0 (this week) — kickoff, security/network intake, sample payloads, confirm SSO/KMS approach. Owner: Wellspire (Anna, Carlos)
2) Week 1 — schema finalization + contract SOW sign (Redwood Legal + Wellspire procurement). Owner: Marissa (schema), Ben (commercial)
3) Weeks 2–3 — private deployment prep (VPC peering, KMS), runtime config (batching, streaming SLOs). Owner: Infra + Olga
4) Weeks 4–5 — integration tests: streaming UI wire-up, tool-calling endpoints, structured-output validation harness. Owner: Wellspire eng + Marissa
5) Week 6 — pilot review, quality check, iterate on quantization/batching profiles for cost optimization. Owner: Olga + Ben

Questions for you now:
- Can you share a representative sample payload (no PHI) and one example of an expected structured JSON output?
- Are there any specific schema fields that must be immutable for downstream analytics?
- Do you have a minimum latency SLO for partial streaming (e.g., first-byte < 120ms)?

Attached: redwood-schema-proposal-v0.1.json, initial-action-grid.xlsx.

I'll schedule a 30-min internal run-through with Ben and Marissa this afternoon to align owners and follow-ups.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.inference>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-04-18T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Wellspire pilot — owners, ask list, and timing

Ben/Marissa — quick internal note following Anna's ask and my reply. See the external thread below for context.

Priority actions (owners & ETA):
- Ben: confirm SOW path and whether Wellspire can sign via our standard pilot MSA or needs PO. ETA: EOD Tue 4/19.
- Marissa: take the attached redwood-schema-proposal-v0.1.json and produce: 1) a tight validation schema (JSON Schema draft-07) and 2) a test harness (Postman + small node script) that exercises streaming partials + final payload validation. ETA: first pass by 4/24.
- Olga/Infra: coordinate VPC peering checklist and KMS key exchange (we'll use customer-managed keys). I'll book a netops call with their infra lead — can you confirm availability 4/20–4/21?

Notes on test scope: include both function/tool calling flows we demoed — search lookup (sync) and annotation callback (async). For cost testing, run two scenarios: steady 20 req/s and a burst to 75 req/s for 10 minutes. Use our staging model variant (quantized) and note latency tails.

I'll attach a cleaned action grid after the meeting and share with Anna. Reply here with any blockers.

On Tue, Apr 18, 2028 at 9:12 AM Anna Li <anna@wellspire.health> wrote:
> Thanks again for the demo today — the streaming + function calling example was exactly what our product team needed to see.
> ...

Olga
From: Carlos Ramos <carlos@wellspire.health>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-04-19T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Real-time output + tool-calling kickoff

Hi Olga — attaching a sanitized sample payload and an example of our desired structured output. The sample (wellspire-sample-payload.json) is a ~320-token clinical summary request. The structured output we expect is a JSON object with top-level fields: patientId (stable), summarySegments (array of {start_offset,end_offset,content}), tags (array), and references (array of {sourceId,score}).

Latency notes: for interactive UI we want first-byte streaming within 150ms ideally; final response within 1.8s for the 320-token case. For longer reports we'll accept higher tails but would like guidance on chunked partials vs single-shot.

Also, procurement asked if the pilot needs an MSA or if a simple pilot SOW works. Ben — can you advise?

Carlos Ramos
Senior Engineering Manager
Wellspire Health
Attachment: wellspire-sample-payload.json
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.inference>
To: Anna Li <anna@wellspire.health>, Carlos Ramos <carlos@wellspire.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-04-20T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot kickoff confirmed — action grid & next steps

Team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per the netops call this morning we have dates for VPC peering (4/25) and KMS exchange (4/26). Ben confirmed that procurement is comfortable with a pilot SOW (no full MSA required for the pilot) — Ben, please share the SOW template and estimated pilot cost so Anna can move it to procurement.

Attached I'm sharing the cleaned implementation action grid (wellspire-implementation-action-grid-v1.xlsx) and a short runtime test plan (runtime-test-plan.md). Highlights / owners:
- 4/20–4/24: Schema finalization + validation harness (Marissa)
- 4/25–4/26: Networking & KMS (Infra + Wellspire netops)
- 4/27–5/03: Integration + streaming UI wiring, tool-calling callbacks, and load tests (joint)
- 5/04: Pilot quality review and cost optimizations (Olga + Ben)

Immediate asks for Wellspire: share redacted sample patient flows (if possible) and confirm SSO approach (SAML vs OIDC).

I'll open a shared Drive folder (link above) and drop the validation schema once Marissa posts it.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth pilot.

Olga Petrov
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
